tools.name: read_document

tools.name: list_document_requests
tools.description: List one page of project document requests.

tools.name: attach_requested_document
tools.description: Attach a document available in this workstation to an open project request.

tools.name: read_requested_document
tools.description: Read the document attached to a fulfilled project request.

tools.description: Create a draft supplier order using its supplier quote reference.

tools.description: Read current supplier orders and recorded commitments.
